description:
In Her Obedient Toy, a simple guy works under a seductive yet strict and demanding boss, who is also a very dominant woman. He becomes completely submissive to his boss. He does this to protect — and even impress — another woman who works at the company. But does he have the strength to face every challenge and complete every task his boss gives him… even when some of them become dangerously sensual?

**Original Webtoon:**
